proof_body:
by
  intro u c K a b hu hK h t ht
  have hab : a ≤ b := ht.1.trans ht.2
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc a b, w s = u s :=
    ⟨Set.IccExtend hab ((Set.Icc a b).restrict u),
      (continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict.1 hu).Icc_extend',
      fun s hs => Set.IccExtend_of_mem hab _ hs⟩
  have hint : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc a b, (∫ r in a..s, u r) = ∫ r in a..s, w r := by
    intro s hs
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun r hr => ?_)
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hs.1] at hr
    exact (hwu r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hs.2⟩).symm
  have hW : ∀ s, HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ r in a..s, w r) (w s) s :=
    fun s => (hw.integral_hasStrictDerivAt a s).hasDerivAt
  have hd : ∀ s, HasDerivAt
      (fun s => (c + K * ∫ r in a..s, w r) * Real.exp (-(K * (s - a))))
      ((K * w s - K * (c + K * ∫ r in a..s, w r)) * Real.exp (-(K * (s - a)))) s := by
    intro s
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -(K * (s - a))) (-(K * 1)) s :=
      (((hasDerivAt_id s).sub_const a).const_mul K).neg
    have h2 : HasDerivAt
        (fun s => (c + K * ∫ r in a..s, w r) * Real.exp (-(K * (s - a))))
        ((K * w s) * Real.exp (-(K * (s - a))) +
          (c + K * ∫ r in a..s, w r) * (Real.exp (-(K * (s - a))) * (-(K * 1)))) s :=
      (((hW s).const_mul K).const_add c).mul h1.exp
    exact h2.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hanti : AntitoneOn
      (fun s => (c + K * ∫ r in a..s, w r) * Real.exp (-(K * (s - a)))) (Set.Icc a b) := by
    refine antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos
      (f' := fun s => (K * w s - K * (c + K * ∫ r in a..s, w r)) * Real.exp (-(K * (s - a))))
      (convex_Icc a b) (fun s _ => (hd s).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun s _ => (hd s).hasDerivWithinAt) ?_
    intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    have hs' : s ∈ Set.Icc a b := ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩
    have h3 := h s hs'
    rw [hint s hs', ← hwu s hs'] at h3
    refine mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ?_ (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hK
    linarith
  have h4 : (c + K * ∫ r in a..t, w r) * Real.exp (-(K * (t - a))) ≤
      (c + K * ∫ r in a..a, w r) * Real.exp (-(K * (a - a))) :=
    hanti (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 hab) ht ht.1
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_same, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_self, neg_zero,
    Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at h4
  have h5 := h t ht
  rw [hint t ht] at h5
  have hone : Real.exp (-(K * (t - a))) * Real.exp (K * (t - a)) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  calc u t ≤ c + K * ∫ r in a..t, w r := h5
    _ = (c + K * ∫ r in a..t, w r) * Real.exp (-(K * (t - a))) * Real.exp (K * (t - a)) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, hone, mul_one]
    _ ≤ c * Real.exp (K * (t - a)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 (Real.exp_pos _).le
target_source: ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ) (c K a b : ℝ), ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc a b) → 0 ≤ K → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, u t ≤ c + K * ∫ s in a..t, u s) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, u t ≤ c * Real.exp (K * (t - a))
